layer_3_action.subject: A massive, arid floodplain dominated by giant red sandstone outcrops
features: Braided river channels with shifting red sand and gravel bars
Massive, weathered red sandstone cliffs in the background
Sparse, hardy vegetation concentrated near the water channels
Intense, direct sunlight creating sharp, dark shadows
A vast, wide-open horizon to accommodate giant flyers
layer_3_action.action: A harsh, majestic landscape under an immense sky. The scale is monumental. The ground is dry, pebbly, and vibrant red. No grass.

visuals.ground: Coarse red sand, pebbles, and sun-baked clay. Vegetation is sparse and scrub-like. No grass.
visuals.water: Multiple shallow, fast-moving channels of silty, reddish water.
visuals.sky: Intense, deep blue; wide-angle perspective to emphasize the scale of the sky.
